studies.name: Bull Momentum
studies.headline: Best bull detector is right 82% of the time it says bull (the current one: 63%); the best coin ranker's top 3 beat the average coin by 1.1% a week in bull markets.

shortlist.name: A01 Rotation
shortlist.hypothesis: Coins that outperformed over the past three weeks keep outperforming over the next week; holding only those above their own 50-day average (dual momentum) and only in bull regimes avoids the momentum crashes that follow market turns.
shortlist.verdict_now_why: does not beat Bitcoin at the same risk over development (-3.4%/yr)
